$description: [Pack example] The slice recipe: the pack template pov-story-spine scaled to 30 s with its slice-30 variant (100 BPM; every segment inside the template limits and the motion presets: end card 198 frames, demo 150 frames), with lines from the original Persian guide script (fictional brand). Persian forms are proposed until a named native editor signs. voiceMs scripts the mock voice so every spoken beat lasts its frame budget: speech + the first-run hold of 13 frames (fake motion: 12 + seed % 3, seed 1).

beats.name: POV hook
beats.purpose: Set the scene in one breath
beats.visual: flat living room at night, the lead on a phone

onScreenText.fa:
شب یلداست، خونه‌ی مامان‌بزرگ غوغاست.
منم این‌ور، غرق بازی‌ام.
onScreenText.en:
Grandma's house is loud tonight.
And I'm deep in a game.

beats.name: The elder calls
beats.purpose: A playful ritual pulls at the lead
beats.visual: the elder enters with a speech bubble

onScreenText.fa: بیا یه فال حافظ برات بگیرم!
onScreenText.en: "Come here, let me read your palm!"

beats.name: Dark card
beats.visual: dark card with a question bubble

beats.name: Phone demo

onScreenText.fa: ببین: حروف رو می‌کشم، کلمه درمیاد.
onScreenText.en: Look: drag the letters, the word pops out.

beats.motion: iris into the phone, swipe path

beats.name: Chant cards
beats.motion: card cut and punch per card

onScreenText.fa:
یلدا با حرفینو بلندتره!
امشب نوبت توئه!
onScreenText.en:
One more word before bed.
Your turn tonight.
